# dsh-gateway-notify
A DeepSeek Harness plugin that pushes to your phone or team chat when an agent turn ends after runni
ng a while, when a turn fails, or when the agent has been waiting on your approval.
中文：dsh 的长任务结束、失败或卡在等你审批时，推送到 ntfy、Bark、Gotify、Server酱、飞书、钉钉、企业微信、Telegram 或任意 webhook。默认不发送提示词和回复正文。
Ported from `@magpie-community/gateway-notify` (MIT, © magpie-community contributors). The channel c
ode is theirs, nearly unchanged.
## When it pushes
| dsh event | Push |
| `turn/end` with `completed` or `max-tokens`, turn ran ≥ `minMinutes` | ✅ done, with duration and m

odel |
| `turn/end` with `error` | ❌ failed, with the error message (any duration, if `errors` is on

) |
| `approval/asked` not decided within `approvalDelaySeconds` | ⏳ needs approval, with the tool n

ame |
| `turn/end` with `aborted` | nothing: you pressed stop, so you're at the keyboard |
| `blocke
d`, `interrupted`, `forked` | nothing |
Subagent sessions (those with a parent session) stay quiet unless `subagents: true`. At most one pus
h per session per `cooldownSeconds`.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Requires Node ≥ 24.9 (the same as dsh). Tested with dsh 0.2.1-rc.5.
## Configure
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Put tokens, keys and webhook URLs in environment variables and reference them as `env:NAME`; then no
thing secret sits in the profile. This also works inside nested values such as a generic webhook's `
headers` (`authorization: env:HOOK_AUTH`). If the variable is unset or empty and the field is requir
ed, that channel is skipped (nothing is sent to it); other channels still send.
| Option | Default | Meaning |

| `channels` | `[]` | where to push (below) |
| `minMinutes` | `3` | only push for turns at least th

is long |
| `cooldownSeconds` | `30` | at most one push per session in this window |
| `errors` | `t

rue` | push failed turns, however short |
| `approvals` | `true` | push approvals left waiting |
| `

approvalDelaySeconds` | `60` | how long an approval waits before the push |
| `subagents` | `false`

| also push for subagent sessions |
| `includeText` | `false` | add the start of the final reply |
|

`maxTextLength` | `200` | how much of it |
| `lang` | `en` | `en` or `zh` |
### Channels
| `type` | Needs | Optional |

| `ntfy` | `topic` | `server` (default ntfy.sh), `token`, `priority`, `tags` |
| `bark` | `key` | `s

erver` (default api.day.app), `group`, `sound` |
| `gotify` | `server`, `token` | `priority` |
| `se

rverchan` | `key` (SCT… or sctp…) | |
| `feishu` | `webhook` | `secret` |
| `dingtalk` | `webhook` |

`secret` |
| `wecom` | `webhook` | |
| `telegram` | `token`, `chatId` | `server` |
| `webhook` | `u
rl` | `headers`; body is `{ title, body, event }` |
Add `off: true` to keep a channel in config without sending to it.
Each request times out after 10 seconds. A channel that times out, refuses the connection, answers a
n HTTP error, or answers 200 with an error code in the body (as the Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom and Tele
gram bots do) counts as a failed send. The failure is swallowed: it never throws into the agent and
never stops the other channels.
## Privacy
By default a push carries only the project folder name, the duration, the model, and for failures th
e error message. Prompts and replies are not sent unless you turn on `includeText`. Each channel is
one HTTPS POST to the service you configured; nothing goes anywhere else.
## Differences from the magpie gateway version
The magpie version sits in an API gateway and has to infer from raw requests when a turn starts and
ends, which requests belong to a subagent or a Claude Code background agent, and whether a failure i
s a retry. dsh reports these directly, so this port:
- listens to dsh's `session/event` stream (`turn/start`, `turn/end` and its reason, `assistant/messa

ge`, `approval/asked`, `approval/decided`) instead of request/response hooks;
- identifies subagents

by the session's `parentSession` instead of heuristics;
- drops the failure hold window: dsh's own

retry layer has finished by the time `turn/end` reports an error;
- drops the `agents` and `allOrigi

ns` filters, which picked clients in a shared gateway;
- adds the approval-waiting push and `env:NAM

E` secrets;
- drops a session's open turn and cooldown stamp on dsh's `session/disposed`, so a long-
running host does not keep state for every session it has seen.
